body_lead: In a first-of-its-kind move, the Kerala High Court has issued directions making it mandatory for all district courts in the state to adopt Adalat AI, an artificial intelligence-based speech-to-text transcription tool, for recording witness statements and evidence. The new system will be enforced across all trial courts from November 1, 2025. According to an official memorandum dated September 27, the initiative seeks to reduce delays in recording evidence and modernise deposition procedures in line with earlier circulars of the High Court.
